title: Tech Note: Engaging Database Tests in your 4D Database
author: Vance Villanueva, Technical Services Engineer, 4D Inc.

historical_commentary.text: The User parameter mechanism (SET/GET DATABASE PARAMETER with the User param value selector, plus --user-param on the command line and user_param in .4DLink files) introduced in v17R3 is still a current, valid 4D feature for automating test/mode selection at startup, and remains unchanged in modern 4D versions.
related_updates: The User parameter database parameter feature remains current and unchanged since its v17R3 introduction
4D has since also grown its testing ecosystem more broadly, but this specific startup-parameter mechanism is still a valid technique
